feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Scots urged to use A&E 'only when necessary' amid 'significant pressures'
articles.summary: Scotland's A&E departments are under "significant pressures" heading into winter, the nation's health secretary has conceded.

articles.title: Pupils at Edinburgh Academy suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
articles.summary: Pupils at Edinburgh Academy suffered "dreadful abuse" over four decades while the school sought to protect its reputation and ignored complaints, the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry has found.

articles.title: Hundreds more prisoners being released early
articles.summary: Hundreds more prisoners are being released early this morning, as part of a scheme to ease overcrowding in Britain's jails.

articles.title: Specialists to remove 25 lorry loads of waste from site a day
articles.summary: An operation has started to remove 18,000 tonnes of waste from an illegal site in Wigan.

articles.title: Storms hitting UK at same time led to one of country's wettest days on record
articles.summary: Storms Austen and Boelo striking different parts of the UK at the same time contributed to 24 October being one of the wettest days Britain has ever seen.

articles.title: High air pollution alert issued as fog threatens travel disruption
articles.summary: Dense fog has led to a "high" air pollution alert being issued in London - as forecasters warn of difficult travel conditions and transport delays across much of the UK.

articles.title: Harry delivers solo speech to EU parliament after Meghan pulls out
articles.summary: Prince Harry has delivered a keynote address to the European parliament on online child safety, a day after his wife, Meghan, pulled out of what should have been a joint speech.

articles.title: James Bulger's mother 'relieved' as killer to remain in prison
articles.summary: James Bulger's mother has spoken of her overwhelming relief after the Parole Board said one of her son's killers should stay in prison.

articles.title: Killer couple both now dead and take secret of victim's remains to the grave
articles.summary: Two killers who murdered a vulnerable woman have both now died - taking the secret of where they hid their victim's remains to the grave.
